newsitem.title: CANADA: CAW on Canadian Airlines - announcement.
newsitem.headline: CAW on Canadian Airlines - announcement.

text.p: president Buzz Hargrove said Canadian's demand wage roll-backs from its workers is no solution. "This is about the banks wanting to get quick cash out of the workers again. The workers gave in 1992, the workers gave in 1994 and the workers gave again in 1995."
American Airlines is the major shareholder in Canadian Airlines. American Airlines reported profits of U.S.$167 million in 1995 and expects to improve its profits in 1996.
Hargrove will hold a news conference today at 1.30p.m. in the Giovanni Room at the Toronto Colony Hotel on 89 Chestnut Street.
Media can call in to participate in the press conference by dialing (416) 620-4111. The operator will provide instructions as to how media can ask questions during the press conference.
The CAW represents approximately 3700 workers at Canadian Airlines who work as passenger and reservations agents, as well as in cargo.
